```{r libraries, include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(refugees)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(geojsonio)
library(scales)
```

## UNHCR Refugee Population Statistics

Data in this section comes from the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) Refugee Data Finder, accessed through the `refugees` R package. The package provides data on forcibly displaced populations, including refugees, asylum-seekers, internally displaced people (IDPs), and stateless persons spanning over 70 years of data collection.

The `refugees` package includes several datasets:

-   **population**: Forcibly displaced and stateless persons by year and country pairs
-   **flows**: Numbers of people forced to flee annually since 1962
-   **asylum_applications**: Asylum application data by procedure and application type
-   **asylum_decisions**: Asylum outcomes (recognized, rejected, closed)
-   **demographics**: Demographic disaggregation by age and sex
-   **solutions**: Durable solutions (repatriation, resettlement)
-   **idmc**: Internal Displacement Monitoring Centre data on conflict-induced IDPs
-   **unrwa**: Palestine refugees under UNRWA mandate

More information: [UNHCR Refugee Data Finder](https://www.unhcr.org/refugee-statistics/)

## Dataset Overview

First, I'll explore the structure of the main datasets available in the package.

### Population Dataset

The `population` dataset is the core dataset containing refugee counts by origin and asylum country pairs.

```{r explore_population}
glimpse(population)
```

```{r population_summary}
cat("Population dataset dimensions:", nrow(population), "rows x", ncol(population), "columns\n")
cat("Year range:", min(population$year), "-", max(population$year), "\n")
cat("Number of unique origin countries:", n_distinct(population$coo_name), "\n")
cat("Number of unique asylum countries:", n_distinct(population$coa_name), "\n")
```

### Flows Dataset

The `flows` dataset tracks annual displacement flows.

```{r explore_flows}
glimpse(flows)
```

```{r flows_summary}
cat("Flows dataset dimensions:", nrow(flows), "rows x", ncol(flows), "columns\n")
cat("Year range:", min(flows$year), "-", max(flows$year), "\n")
```

## Variable Documentation

Let's document the key variables in the population dataset:

```{r variable_docs}
population_vars <- tibble(
  Variable = c("year", "coo_name", "coo", "coo_iso", "coa_name", "coa", "coa_iso",
               "refugees", "asylum_seekers", "returned_refugees", "idps",
               "returned_idps", "stateless", "ooc", "oip", "hst"),
  Description = c(
    "Year of data",
    "Country of origin (full name)",
    "Country of origin (UNHCR code)",
    "Country of origin (ISO 3-letter code)",
    "Country of asylum (full name)",
    "Country of asylum (UNHCR code)",
    "Country of asylum (ISO 3-letter code)",
    "Number of refugees",
    "Number of asylum seekers",
    "Returned refugees",
    "Internally displaced persons",
    "Returned IDPs",
    "Stateless persons",
    "Others of concern",
    "Other people in need of international protection",
    "Host community"
  )
)

knitr::kable(population_vars, caption = "Population dataset variables")
```

## Temporal Coverage Analysis

### Data availability over time

```{r temporal_coverage}
yearly_coverage <- population %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_records = n(),
    n_origins = n_distinct(coo_name),
    n_asylums = n_distinct(coa_name),
    total_refugees = sum(refugees, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_asylum_seekers = sum(asylum_seekers, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_idps = sum(idps, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

plot_ly(yearly_coverage, x = ~year, y = ~n_records, type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
        line = list(color = "#2c7fb8", width = 2),
        marker = list(color = "#2c7fb8", size = 6),
        hovertemplate = "Year: %{x}<br>Records: %{y:,}<extra></extra>") %>%
  layout(
    title = list(text = "UNHCR Data Records Over Time<br><sup>Number of country-pair records per year</sup>"),
    xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of records"),
    annotations = list(
      list(x = 1, y = -0.1, text = "Data: UNHCR | Plot: Irene Pérez-Díez",
           showarrow = FALSE, xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
           xanchor = "right", font = list(size = 10, color = "gray"))
    )
  )
```

### Total displaced persons over time

```{r displaced_over_time}
displacement_trends <- yearly_coverage %>%
  select(year, total_refugees, total_asylum_seekers, total_idps) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -year, names_to = "category", values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      category == "total_refugees" ~ "Refugees",
      category == "total_asylum_seekers" ~ "Asylum Seekers",
      category == "total_idps" ~ "IDPs"
    ),
    count_millions = count / 1e6
  )

colors <- c("Refugees" = "#e41a1c", "Asylum Seekers" = "#377eb8", "IDPs" = "#4daf4a")

plot_ly(displacement_trends, x = ~year, y = ~count_millions, color = ~category,
        colors = colors, type = "scatter", mode = "lines",
        line = list(width = 2),
        hovertemplate = "Year: %{x}<br>%{y:.2f}M<extra>%{fullData.name}</extra>") %>%
  layout(
    title = list(text = "Global Displacement Trends<br><sup>Millions of displaced persons by category</sup>"),
    xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Persons (millions)"),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.15),
    annotations = list(
      list(x = 1, y = -0.2, text = "Data: UNHCR | Plot: Irene Pérez-Díez",
           showarrow = FALSE, xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
           xanchor = "right", font = list(size = 10, color = "gray"))
    )
  )
```

## Geographic Coverage Analysis

### Missing data by country of origin

```{r origin_coverage}
origin_coverage <- population %>%
  filter(year >= 1990) %>%
  group_by(coo_iso) %>%
  summarise(
    years_with_data = n_distinct(year),
    total_years = n_distinct(population$year[population$year >= 1990])
  ) %>%
  mutate(coverage_pct = years_with_data / total_years * 100)

plot_ly(origin_coverage, x = ~coverage_pct, type = "histogram",
        marker = list(color = "#808000", line = list(color = "white", width = 1)),
        xbins = list(size = 10),
        hovertemplate = "Coverage: %{x}%<br>Countries: %{y}<extra></extra>") %>%
  layout(
    title = list(text = "Data Coverage by Country of Origin (1990-present)<br><sup>Percentage of years with recorded data</sup>"),
    xaxis = list(title = "Coverage (%)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of countries"),
    annotations = list(
      list(x = 1, y = -0.15, text = "Data: UNHCR | Plot: Irene Pérez-Díez",
           showarrow = FALSE, xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
           xanchor = "right", font = list(size = 10, color = "gray"))
    )
  )
```

### Geographic visualization of refugee origins

```{r load_geodata}
#| output: false
world_geo <- sf::st_read(here("data/spatial/world.geojson"))
```

```{r origin_map, dpi=300, fig.height=20, fig.width=50}
#| column: screen
latest_year <- max(population$year)

refugees_by_origin <- population %>%
  filter(year == latest_year) %>%
  group_by(coo_iso) %>%
  summarise(total_refugees = sum(refugees, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(coo_iso))

origin_map_data <- world_geo %>%
  left_join(refugees_by_origin, by = c("ISO_A3" = "coo_iso"))

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = origin_map_data, aes(fill = total_refugees / 1e6), size = 0, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "inferno",
    trans = "log10",
    breaks = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10),
    labels = c("1K", "10K", "100K", "1M", "10M"),
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "Refugees (log scale)",
    guide = guide_legend(keyheight = unit(6, units = "mm"),
                         keywidth = unit(18, units = "mm"),
                         label.position = "bottom",
                         title.position = 'top', nrow = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Refugee Population by Country of Origin -", latest_year),
    subtitle = "Total number of refugees originating from each country",
    caption = "Data: UNHCR | Plot: Irene Pérez-Díez"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(color = "#514A44"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 36, hjust = 0.01, color = "#514A44",
                              margin = margin(b = -0.1, t = 0.4, l = 2, unit = "cm")),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 30, hjust = 0.01, color = "#514A44",
                                  margin = margin(b = -0.1, t = 0.43, l = 2, unit = "cm")),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 24, color = "#514A44",
                                margin = margin(b = 0.3, r = -99, unit = "cm")),
    legend.position = c(0.06, 0.09),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 24, color = "#514A44"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 24, color = "#514A44")
  ) +
  coord_sf()
```

## Top Origin and Destination Countries

### Top 10 refugee origin countries over time

```{r top_origins}
top_origins <- population %>%
  group_by(coo_name) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(refugees, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  slice_max(total, n = 10) %>%
  pull(coo_name)

origin_timeseries <- population %>%
  filter(coo_name %in% top_origins) %>%
  group_by(year, coo_name) %>%
  summarise(refugees = sum(refugees, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(refugees_millions = refugees / 1e6)

plot_ly(origin_timeseries, x = ~year, y = ~refugees_millions, color = ~coo_name,
        type = "scatter", mode = "lines", line = list(width = 2),
        hovertemplate = "Year: %{x}<br>Refugees: %{y:.2f}M<extra>%{fullData.name}</extra>") %>%
  layout(
    title = list(text = "Top 10 Refugee Origin Countries Over Time<br><sup>Total refugees by country of origin</sup>"),
    xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Refugees (millions)"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Country of Origin")),
    annotations = list(
      list(x = 1, y = -0.1, text = "Data: UNHCR | Plot: Irene Pérez-Díez",
           showarrow = FALSE, xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
           xanchor = "right", font = list(size = 10, color = "gray"))
    )
  )
```

## Refugee Origins Over Time: Small Multiples

An animated map was too heavy workload for my computer. Instead, we use a faceted approach showing maps at key intervals to visualize how refugee origins have shifted over the decades.

```{r small_multiples_map, dpi=300, fig.height=12, fig.width=16}
#| column: screen
selected_years <- c(1990, 2000, 2010, 2015, 2020, max(population$year))

refugees_selected_years <- population %>%
  filter(year %in% selected_years) %>%
  group_by(year, coo_iso) %>%
  summarise(total_refugees = sum(refugees, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!is.na(coo_iso))

facet_map_data <- world_geo %>%
  cross_join(tibble(year = selected_years)) %>%
  left_join(refugees_selected_years, by = c("ISO_A3" = "coo_iso", "year" = "year"))

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = facet_map_data, aes(fill = total_refugees / 1e6), size = 0, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "inferno",
    trans = "log10",
    breaks = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10),
    labels = c("1K", "10K", "100K", "1M", "10M"),
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "Refugees"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~year, ncol = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Refugee Population by Country of Origin Over Time",
    subtitle = "Evolution of displacement patterns from 1990 to present",
    caption = "Data: UNHCR | Plot: Irene Pérez-Díez"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(color = "#514A44"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, hjust = 0.5, color = "#514A44", face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, color = "#514A44"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray50"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "#514A44", face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  coord_sf()
```

### Interactive Timeline Map

An interactive choropleth map with a year slider allows exploration of refugee origins across all years.

```{r interactive_map}
refugees_by_year_origin <- population %>%
  filter(year >= 1990) %>%
  group_by(year, coo_iso, coo_name) %>%
  summarise(total_refugees = sum(refugees, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(!is.na(coo_iso))

plot_ly(
  data = refugees_by_year_origin,
  type = "choropleth",
  locations = ~coo_iso,
  z = ~log10(total_refugees + 1),
  frame = ~year,
  text = ~paste(coo_name, "<br>Refugees:", scales::comma(total_refugees)),
  hoverinfo = "text",
  colorscale = "Inferno",
  reversescale = TRUE,
  zmin = 0,
  zmax = 7,
  colorbar = list(
    title = "Refugees<br>(log scale)",
    tickvals = c(0, 2, 4, 6),
    ticktext = c("1", "100", "10K", "1M")
  )
) %>%
  layout(
    title = list(text = "Refugee Population by Country of Origin<br><sup>Use slider to explore changes over time</sup>"),
    geo = list(
      showframe = FALSE,
      showcoastlines = TRUE,
      projection = list(type = "natural earth")
    ),
    annotations = list(
      list(x = 1, y = -0.05, text = "Data: UNHCR | Plot: Irene Pérez-Díez",
           showarrow = FALSE, xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
           xanchor = "right", font = list(size = 10, color = "gray"))
    )
  ) %>%
  animation_opts(frame = 500, transition = 300, redraw = FALSE) %>%
  animation_slider(currentvalue = list(prefix = "Year: "))
```

## Data Quality Assessment

### Missing values summary

```{r missing_summary}
missing_summary <- population %>%
  summarise(
    refugees_na = sum(is.na(refugees)),
    refugees_na_pct = mean(is.na(refugees)) * 100,
    asylum_seekers_na = sum(is.na(asylum_seekers)),
    asylum_seekers_na_pct = mean(is.na(asylum_seekers)) * 100,
    idps_na = sum(is.na(idps)),
    idps_na_pct = mean(is.na(idps)) * 100,
    coo_iso_na = sum(is.na(coo_iso)),
    coa_iso_na = sum(is.na(coa_iso))
  )

knitr::kable(
  tibble(
    Variable = c("refugees", "asylum_seekers", "idps", "coo_iso", "coa_iso"),
    `Missing Count` = c(missing_summary$refugees_na, missing_summary$asylum_seekers_na,
                        missing_summary$idps_na, missing_summary$coo_iso_na,
                        missing_summary$coa_iso_na),
    `Missing %` = c(missing_summary$refugees_na_pct, missing_summary$asylum_seekers_na_pct,
                    missing_summary$idps_na_pct,
                    missing_summary$coo_iso_na / nrow(population) * 100,
                    missing_summary$coa_iso_na / nrow(population) * 100)
  ),
  caption = "Missing values in population dataset",
  digits = 2
)
```

### ISO code coverage

```{r iso_coverage}
iso_coverage <- population %>%
  summarise(
    total_records = n(),
    has_coo_iso = sum(!is.na(coo_iso)),
    has_coa_iso = sum(!is.na(coa_iso)),
    has_both_iso = sum(!is.na(coo_iso) & !is.na(coa_iso))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    coo_iso_pct = has_coo_iso / total_records * 100,
    coa_iso_pct = has_coa_iso / total_records * 100,
    both_iso_pct = has_both_iso / total_records * 100
  )

cat("ISO code coverage for data integration:\n")
cat(sprintf("- Origin country ISO code: %.1f%%\n", iso_coverage$coo_iso_pct))
cat(sprintf("- Asylum country ISO code: %.1f%%\n", iso_coverage$coa_iso_pct))
cat(sprintf("- Both ISO codes available: %.1f%%\n", iso_coverage$both_iso_pct))
```

## Summary for Integration

Key findings for data integration with poverty, conflict, and water scarcity datasets:

1.  **Join key**: Use `coo_iso` (origin) and `coa_iso` (asylum) ISO 3-letter codes
2.  **Temporal range**: Data spans from 1951, but most comprehensive from 1990 onwards
3.  **Primary metrics for analysis**:
    -   `refugees`: Main outcome variable for migration analysis
    -   `asylum_seekers`: Leading indicator of refugee flows
    -   `idps`: Internal displacement (potential future refugees)
4.  **Aggregation options**:
    -   By origin country: Total refugees fleeing each country
    -   By asylum country: Total refugees hosted
    -   By origin-asylum pairs: Specific migration corridors

```{r save_summary}
integration_summary <- population %>%
  filter(year >= 1990) %>%
  group_by(year, coo_iso) %>%
  summarise(
    total_refugees = sum(refugees, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_asylum_seekers = sum(asylum_seekers, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_idps = sum(idps, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(coo_iso))

cat("\nIntegration-ready dataset preview:\n")
cat(sprintf("- Rows: %d\n", nrow(integration_summary)))
cat(sprintf("- Countries: %d\n", n_distinct(integration_summary$coo_iso)))
cat(sprintf("- Years: %d-%d\n", min(integration_summary$year), max(integration_summary$year)))
```
